abort.already_configured: Device Lifecycle is already configured. Add new purchases or runtime tracking from the existing integration.

user.title: Add purchase
user.description: Record a Purchase even if no devices have arrived or been added to Home Assistant yet. You can link physical devices now or attach Assets to this Purchase later.

data_description.device_ids: Leave empty to create the Purchase before any devices exist. If selected, a physical Home Assistant device can belong to only one active Purchase.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Use Manual only for another end date.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price. The configured Home Assistant currency is stored with the purchase.
data_description.receipt_url: Optional URL to a receipt, invoice or other purchase document.
data_description.installed_date: For selected devices, leave empty to use the Purchase date as their initial Installation date. You can edit or clear it later.

reconfigure.title: Edit purchase

data_description.device_ids: This selector shows and manages physical Home Assistant Device Registry devices only. Manually managed Device Lifecycle Assets are listed separately above. Obvious system and software devices are filtered out.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Manual uses the date below.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price. The purchase keeps the currency captured when it was created.
data_description.receipt_url: Optional URL to a receipt, invoice or other purchase document.
data_description.installed_date: The installation date can be changed or cleared independently of the purchase date.

user.title: Add runtime tracking
user.description: First choose the physical device and runtime detection method. Next, select a source entity suitable for that method.

data_description.device_id: The Runtime hours sensor is linked to this physical Home Assistant device and its persistent Device Lifecycle Asset. Service-type HA devices are rejected.
data_description.runtime_mode: Choose whether runtime is detected from an entity being on or from measured power.

runtime_source.title: Configure runtime source
runtime_source.description: The source list is filtered for the selected tracking method. Power mode shows only actual power sensors; on-state mode shows sensible on/off entities.

data_description.source_entity_id: Power mode accepts Power device-class sensors whose unit can be converted to watts. On-state mode accepts switches, lights, binary sensors, input booleans and fans. Device Lifecycle's own entities are excluded.
data_description.power_threshold: Runtime starts when the source power, normalized to watts, rises above this threshold.
data_description.power_hysteresis: Prevents toggling around the threshold. Example: 10 W threshold and 2 W hysteresis starts above 10 W and stops below 8 W. Must be between 0 and the threshold.

reconfigure.title: Edit runtime tracking
reconfigure.description: Choose the runtime detection method. Next, select a source entity suitable for that method. The tracked physical device is unchanged.

data_description.runtime_mode: Choose whether runtime is detected from an entity being on or from measured power.

reconfigure_source.title: Configure runtime source
reconfigure_source.description: The source list is filtered for the selected tracking method. Power threshold and hysteresis are shown only in power mode.

data_description.source_entity_id: Select a source suitable for the chosen mode. Device Lifecycle's own entities are excluded.
data_description.power_threshold: Runtime starts when the source power, normalized to watts, rises above this threshold.
data_description.power_hysteresis: Example: 10 W threshold and 2 W hysteresis stops only below 8 W. Existing trackers default to 0 W hysteresis, preserving old behavior.
